'''Mezeg''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]]. Aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it had strict enforcement at its [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] terminals, sometimes guarding them with [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], freight [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] passed by Mezeg's terminal and had to go through an inspection from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in search of stray [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. She managed to pass the inspection despite hiding two Jedi&mdash;[[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] and [[Kina Ha]]&mdash;in her ship.<ref name="IC 501st" />
